stories.title: Mistral Large 4
stories.reason: New flagship open-weight model from Mistral: ~1T-param MoE, strong on coding/cyber/agent benchmarks, weights due end of month.
key_facts: ~1T total params, 52B active (MoE), natively multimodal hybrid instruct+reasoning
Trained on 3,800 NVIDIA GB200 GPUs in Mistral's own EU datacenters
82% on reproduce-and-patch vuln test, 93% on Cybench, top-5 on Artificial Analysis Cyber Index
61.7% DeepSWE v1.1; ranked 2nd of 5 in a blind human coding eval, behind Claude Opus 5
$1.36/$4.18 per M input/output tokens; open weights promised by month's end; funded by a EUR3B Series D

stories.title: LLMs are making formal software verification feasible at a much larger scale
stories.reason: Anthropic had Claude formally prove security properties for 123 real-world libraries down to the assembly level, finding hundreds of real bugs along the way.
key_facts: Claude proved security properties at the RISC-V assembly level for 123 open-source libraries across 239 fuzz-test entry points; ~180M lines of Rocq proofs
Found and patched hundreds of bugs, incl. a counter underflow, an OOB read needing a 64MB input and 2GB+ RAM, and a rediscovered CVE-2026-56132 in libexpat
Built a Rust Python interpreter and proved 99.95% CPython-semantic match across 1.7M random programs
Opus 5.5 used ~40% fewer tokens than Opus 5 on verification tasks; agents sharing a proof workspace used 17% fewer tokens than solo agents
Context: seL4 took ~2 person-years to build and ~20 to verify by hand

stories.title: Claude Duet
stories.reason: Anthropic's first autonomous personal-agent product: works across 6,000+ connectors, briefs you proactively, asks before sensitive actions.
key_facts: Research-preview personal AI agent; works cloud-side across 6,000+ connectors (Gmail, Slack, Drive, Stripe, QuickBooks, Shopify)
Asks before sensitive actions (sending messages, paying); gives a proactive morning briefing, then stays quiet until needed
Pro/Max subscribers only, US-only, waitlist; shares the same usage limits as the rest of Claude; powered by Opus 5.5
Not yet available on Team or Enterprise plans; standalone iOS/Android apps plus claude.ai

stories.title: China-Linked Hackers Use ARTEX AI Agents in ConnectWise Supply Chain Attack
stories.reason: A China-linked actor ran AI pentest agents at machine speed to breach ConnectWise's cloud identities, with hard numbers on scale and speed.
key_facts: ARTEX is a Go agentic pentest framework later closed-sourced after abuse; actor tracked as Storm-0940 / TAG-217
Oct 10-14: password-spray hit 327 accounts across 8 orgs, 151,000+ failed logons, peaking at 2,900/min
Attempted sign-ins across 2,250+ tenants; attackers reached privileged access in under 3 hours in several cases
Zscaler found an ARTEX deployment configured with DeepSeek, GLM and Grok, with prompts seeking bulk PII and payment-gateway keys
ConnectWise took services offline and is restoring them in phases

stories.title: OpenCode Flaw Lets Malicious MCP Servers Execute Code During Sign-In on Windows and WSL
stories.reason: A malicious MCP server could run arbitrary PowerShell on a developer's machine during OAuth sign-in -- a working agent/MCP attack chain, CVSS 9.8, silently patched.
key_facts: Command-injection via a malicious remote MCP server's OAuth 'authorization endpoint' URL, routed through unescaped PowerShell on Windows/WSL
Affects OpenCode builds 1.0.137-1.18.32 on Windows/WSL only; silently fixed in 1.18.33 (Sept 28), no CVE or advisory issued
Pillar Security proposed CVSS 9.8; disclosed privately Aug 29, published Oct 19; no evidence of in-the-wild exploitation found
Mitigation: upgrade to 1.18.33+, or remove unvetted remote MCP servers and audit with `opencode mcp list`

stories.title: Anthropic tells investors quarterly revenue up nearly 50% to $16.8bn ahead of IPO
stories.reason: Leaked investor numbers show Anthropic's revenue nearly tripling in two quarters and turning a real operating margin ahead of its IPO.
key_facts: Quarterly revenue: ~$4.8bn (Q1) -> $11.5bn (Q2) -> $16.8bn (Q3 2026), Q3 up nearly 50% q/q
Q3 adjusted operating margin 11% (ex stock comp); $1.70 of revenue per $1 of compute spend
Distillation revenue (5-7% of total) was cut back materially in Q3
Anthropic has stopped emphasizing annualized run-rate revenue in investor communications

stories.title: OpenShell – A safe, private runtime for fleets of autonomous AI agents
stories.reason: NVIDIA open-sourced a sandboxed runtime that keeps autonomous agent fleets off real credentials and flags risky new access for human review.
key_facts: Open-source sandboxed runtime for autonomous agent fleets: kernel-level sandboxing, per-connection network policy checks, credential isolation (agents never see real secrets)
A formal-verification 'advisor/prover' flags risky new access (e.g. new hosts) and holds it for human review before it applies
Kubernetes/Helm gateway control plane; SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust; ~1,852 commits, ~18k stars, 1.8k forks
Still an early 0.1.x release line; no published Releases/Packages shown on the repo page

stories.title: OlmoEarth v1.3: State-of-the-art embeddings for the whole planet
stories.reason: Ai2's fully open-weight satellite embedding model got 82% cheaper to train while matching its predecessor's accuracy and beating Google/other baselines on most evals.
key_facts: Open-weight satellite embedding model: a year of Sentinel-1/2 + Landsat time series -> a 128-dim vector per 10m pixel (64-dim variant also usable)
Beats AlphaEarth Foundations and Tessera v2 on 20/27 and 18/27 of 27 evaluations respectively; introduces a new PLANTEUR tropical crop-type benchmark
v1.3 training cost ~$2,720 in rented H100 time vs $5,100 (v1.2) and $15,060 (v1) -- 82% cheaper than v1 for comparable fine-tuning accuracy
Fully open: weights, pretraining data and code, under the OlmoEarth Artifact License; precomputed global embeddings (2023-2025) published on Source Cooperative
